plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Li-Liu 1+1.9 加权筛 · SW-7001 · 交换筛的两个单边积分界
plain_statement.en: New route · Li-Liu 1+1.9 weighted sieve · SW-7001 · Edge-integral bounds for the switching sieve

brief.zh: 对应 Li–Liu 1+1.9 筛法的 g3、g8 系数解析上界：利用 exp 的泰勒下界给出 8 log(10/9) ≤ 0.84289，利用 log(1+u) 的奇次泰勒上界、精确长除与 log(4/3) 偶次下界给出 8 ∫_2^{8/3} log(t-1)/t dt ≤ 0.60962。
brief.en: Certify the analytic upper bounds for g3 and g8 in the Li–Liu 1+1.9 weighted sieve: 8 log(10/9) ≤ 0.84289 via Taylor lower bounds for exp, and 8 ∫_2^{8/3} log(t-1)/t dt ≤ 0.60962 via odd-degree Taylor upper bounds, exact division by 2+u, and an even-degree lower bound for log(4/3).
